name: ironwallengraving-payment-completed
description: Business event fanout topic for paid orders. When checkout payment completion is confirmed, this topic fans the payment-completed event out to independent downstream order-processing queues.

publishers.name: stripeWebhook
publishers.description: Processes Stripe payment webhooks and can publish payment-completed events.

publishers.name: paymentCompletedOutboxDrainer
publishers.description: Publishes durable payment-completed outbox rows to the fanout topic.

subscribers.name: ironwallengraving-item-stock-queue
subscribers.description: Receives paid-order events for stock adjustment.

subscribers.name: ironwallengraving-customer-confirmation-queue
subscribers.description: Receives paid-order events for customer confirmation email.

subscribers.name: ironwallengraving-owner-notification-queue
subscribers.description: Receives paid-order events for owner notification email.

subscribers.name: ironwallengraving-owner-order-todo-queue
subscribers.description: Receives paid-order events for owner fulfillment to-do creation.

name: ironwallengraving-alarms
description: Regional production alarm notification topic. CloudWatch alarms in the primary region publish operational alerts here.

publishers.name: CloudWatch regional alarms
publishers.description: Publishes API, outbox, inventory reservation, DLQ, and owner to-do queue alerts.

subscribers.name: alarm email recipient
subscribers.description: Email subscription configured from the alarm_email runtime setting.

name: ironwallengraving-alarms-global
description: Global production alarm notification topic in us-east-1. CloudFront/WAF-scope alarms publish here because CloudFront metrics and WAF resources are global/us-east-1 scoped.

publishers.name: CloudWatch global alarms
publishers.description: Publishes global edge alerts such as CloudFront 5xx alarms.

subscribers.name: alarm email recipient
subscribers.description: Email subscription configured from the alarm_email runtime setting.
